#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <stack>
#include <queue>
#define rep(i,l,r) for(int i=(l);i<=(r);++i)
#define per(i,r,l) for(int i=(r);i>=(l);--i)
using namespace std;
const int N=510;
int n,m,P,f[N],g[N],C[N][N],p[N][N],q[N][N];
inline void upd(int &x,int y){((x+=y)>=P)&&(x-=P);}
int main(){
	cin >> n >> m >> P;
	f[0]=1;
	rep(i,0,m){
		C[i][0]=1;
		rep(j,1,i) C[i][j]=(C[i-1][j]+C[i-1][j-1])%P;
	}
	rep(i,1,m) rep(j,1,i){
		upd(f[i],1ll*f[j-1]*f[i-j]%P*(i+1)%P*C[i-1][j-1]%P);
		upd(g[i],(1ll*f[j-1]*g[i-j]+1ll*f[i-j]*g[j-1])%P*(i+1)%P*C[i-1][j-1]%P);
		upd(g[i],1ll*(C[j][2]+C[i-j+1][2])*f[j-1]%P*f[i-j]%P*C[i-1][j-1]%P);
	}
	p[0][0]=1;
	rep(i,1,n){
		rep(j,0,min(i-1,m)) rep(k,0,j){
			upd(p[i][j],1ll*p[i-k-1][j-k]*f[k]%P*C[j][k]%P);	
			upd(q[i][j],(1ll*p[i-k-1][j-k]*g[k]+1ll*q[i-k-1][j-k]*f[k])%P*C[j][k]%P);
		}
		if(i<=m) p[i][i]=f[i],q[i][i]=g[i];
	}
	cout << q[n][m] << endl;
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
